Patterned clusters of electric blue neon glow within this structure, forming interconnected hexagonal modules. The central activity is a dynamic pulse pattern: visible, radial pulses flow outwards from these hexagonal forms. These pulses do not remain static, but instead travel along the connections between adjacent modules, appearing as rhythmic, flowing waves that cycle across the entire digital environment.
